# Session API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

One experimental session, described by the behaviors, data acquisition and manipulations that took place in it.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/session/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/session/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `session` (detail, create, update), `sessions` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/), [`dataacquisition`](/api/modules/dataacquisition/), [`epoch`](/api/stem/epoch/), [`manipulation`](/api/modules/manipulation/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `performed`, `cancelled` **[required]**. Planned: prepared but nothing has happened yet. Performed: this record describes what was done. Cancelled: planned and then dropped; kept for the record. |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `epochs` | list of [`epoch`](/api/stem/epoch/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids **[required]**; nestable |
| `date_time` | datetime; nullable |
| `session_type` | one of `subject`, `specimen` **[required]**. Subject sessions record in-vivo experiments on live animals. Specimen sessions record ex-vivo work on tissue preparations. |
| `subjects` | list of [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) ids; nestable. Live animal subjects involved in this session. Required for subject-type sessions. |
| `specimen_sets` | list of [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) ids; nestable. Ex-vivo tissue preparations involved in this session. Required for specimen-type sessions. |
| `datastorage` | list of [`datastorage`](/api/personal_attributes/datastorage/) ids; nestable |
| `extra_fields` | JSON object |
| `download_links` | JSON object |
| `dataacquisition` | list of [`dataacquisition`](/api/modules/dataacquisition/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `behaviors` | list of [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `manipulations` | list of [`manipulation`](/api/modules/manipulation/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |
| `name_used_in_storage` | string; max 200 characters; nullable |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/session/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('session', load_all=True)
records = resp['sessions']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('session', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.sessions;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/session/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('session', data={"status": "performed", "name": "Session 1", "projects": ["<project-id>"], "session_type": "subject", "subjects": ["<subject-id>"]})
record = resp.json()['session']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('status', 'performed', 'name', 'Session 1', 'projects', {{'<project-id>'}}, 'session_type', 'subject', 'subjects', {{'<subject-id>'}}), 'session');
record = created.session;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/session/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('session', id='<id>', data={"name": "Session 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Session 1 (renamed)'), 'session', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/session/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('session', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'session');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `export` | GET, POST `/api/private/stem/session/<id>/export/` |
| `export_jobs` | GET `/api/private/stem/session/<id>/export-jobs/` |
| `export_job` | GET `/api/private/stem/session/<id>/export-jobs/<job_id>/` |
| `export_job_download` | GET `/api/private/stem/session/<id>/export-jobs/<job_id>/download/` |

`export` returns the session with everything it touches as versioned JSON (see [Exports](/api/export/)); `POST` starts a background export job.

## JSON field schemas

Schemas for the additional fields and repository links of a session. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Session/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### Additional details

- type code `Array` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Session/Array/1.0.0.json)

Any extra parameters you want to add to your session. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `key` | text |
| `value` | object |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "key": "text",
        "value": {}
    }
]
```


### Public repositories

- type code `Repository` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Session/Repository/1.0.0.json)

List public repositories where the data is stored.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `repository` | choice **[required]**; one of `CRCNS`, `DANDI`, `Figshare`, `GitHub`, `Globus`, `Mendeley`, `Zenodo`, `Webshare`, `Other`; default `"DANDI"` |
| `url` | text **[required]**; format url |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "repository": "CRCNS",
        "url": "text"
    }
]
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Session data model page](/datamodel/stem/session/).

## Usage notes

- `session_type` (`subject` or `specimen`) is set on create and cannot be changed afterwards. A subject session lists `subjects`, a specimen session lists `specimen_sets`.
- The order of `datastorage` is kept. To reorder the data storages of an existing session, or to add and remove one, use the [Session data storage endpoint](/api/stem/sessiondatastorage/), whose `order` field sets the position.
- `extra_fields` is a JSON object whose keys start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores; values are strings or numbers.
- Each `download_links` entry is `{"repository": <code>, "url": <url>}`. The URL must include its scheme (`http://`, `https://` or `ftp://`); repository codes are listed under [Public repositories](#public-repositories).
